title: First entry into the stage sets
statement: Let $N=(N_i)_{i\in\mathbb N}$ be a sequence of finite oracle Turing machines over the binary alphabet, with each machine’s query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states pairwise distinct. Let $P_i$ be the positive set at stage $i$ of the stage construction determined by $N$, and let $B=\bigcup_{i\in\mathbb N}P_i$. Every binary word $z\in B$ belongs to $P_{s+1}$ but not to $P_s$ for some $s\in\mathbb N$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence of finite oracle Turing machines over the binary alphabet
For each machine, its query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states are pairwise distinct
